name: TC-BF-003 — 保存Brief草稿不推进状态 [P0]
description: 验证保存草稿不改变迭代状态，再次进入加载草稿内容

steps.expression: (() => { const statusText = document.querySelector('[class*=step], [class*=status]')?.textContent.trim() || document.body.textContent.substring(0, 200); return { statusBefore: statusText }; })()

(() => { const nameInput = document.querySelector('input'); if (nameInput) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(nameInput, '测试迭代草稿'); nameInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return { filled: true }; } return { filled: false }; })()

(() => { const draftBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存草稿')); if (draftBtn) { draftBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
(() => { const statusText = document.querySelector('[class*=step], [class*=status]')?.textContent.trim() || document.body.textContent.substring(0, 200); return { statusAfter: statusText }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: DRAFT_BRIEF状态迭代，当前用户是买手
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 记录当前迭代状态
2. 填写部分内容
3. 点击保存草稿
4. 验证状态未推进
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 保存草稿成功
2. 迭代状态仍为DRAFT_BRIEF
3. 再次进入时加载已保存草稿内容
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/Brief协作
